title: k-Wahl chains and cyclic quotient singularities
summary: We study two-dimensional cyclic quotient singularities defined by $k$-Wahl chains, a class of Hirzebruch--Jung continued fractions obtained inductively starting from $[k+2]$. This class includes the classical Wahl singularities in the case $k=2$ and also contains cyclic quotient singularities arising from $k$-generalized Markov triples. For singularities defined by $k$-Wahl chains, we prove that the combinatorics of the continued fraction is encoded in the special representations of the associated cyclic group.
